events.name: The Orchestra
events.intro:
*Dusk in a meadow. Forty Kricketot tune up, a rustle of wings, a dozen small notes finding each other. Then, all at once, they stop.*

*Every one of them turns, and looks at an empty tree stump.*

*One in the back row plays a wrong note into the silence, and hides.*

*In the long grass, an old Kricketune sits with its back to them.*

success.text: You step up. The stump is warm, as though someone only just left it. Forty small faces tilt up to you, and wait.
You walk past the stump, into the long grass. The orchestra doesn't make a sound. It watches you go.

events.name: The Orchestra: The Drones
events.intro:
*Section 1 of 4.*

The low ones first. A dozen of them, shoulder to shoulder, humming a note so deep it comes up through your boots.

success.text: The drones come in together, one soft wave, and the whole meadow settles under them.

failure.text: The drones come in ragged, half a beat early. Nobody minds. Nobody stops.

events.name: The Orchestra: The Chirps
events.intro:
*Section 2 of 4.*

Now the chirpers. They've been waiting for you, and they've been waiting a long time, and every one of them is trembling.

success.text: The chirps fall in over the drones, bright and even. Somewhere a Kricketot is crying, quietly, with joy.

failure.text: The chirps trip over each other. A Kricketot laughs so hard it hiccups, and carries on.

events.name: The Orchestra: The Trills
events.intro:
*Section 3 of 4.*

The fast ones now. Thin, high, impossible. Their wings blur. They look at you as if you were holding something they thought they'd lost.

success.text: The trills spin out, a thread of silver over everything. The grass itself seems to lean in to hear.

failure.text: The trills scatter. For a moment the meadow is nothing but wings and apologies. Then it finds itself again.

events.name: The Orchestra: The Whole Meadow
events.intro:
*Section 4 of 4.*

All forty. Every wing. You raise your hand and the whole meadow holds its breath, and in the long grass, someone else does too.

success.text: All forty come in at once, and it is, for four beats, the loveliest thing you have ever heard.

failure.text: All forty come in at once, and nearly together, and that will have to be enough.

events.name: The Orchestra: The Last Movement
events.intro:
*At the last movement, the old Kricketune walks out of the grass, slowly, on legs that have forgotten the way.*

*It taps your knee, twice, the way you'd tap a student's shoulder when they've got it right. Then it takes the stump.*

*The orchestra begins again, with the conductor back where it belongs. It plays like it has been waiting years to.*

*The one from the back row hops onto your shoe, and stays.*

success.text: It plays one soft, correct note, just for you. Then it settles against your ankle, and doesn't look back.

effects.text: Conducted the meadow orchestra. Its old conductor took the stump back.

events.name: The Orchestra: Louder
events.intro:
*The orchestra plays louder, to cover. Forty small wings, forty small hearts, and a great deal of sincerity.*

*It is not good. It is, somehow, still wonderful.*

*The one from the back row catches your eye, and winks. Then it hops down, as if that settles it.*

success.text: It plays a wrong note, on purpose this time, and grins up at you. It is yours now, and it knows it.

effects.text: Conducted a meadow orchestra badly, and loudly. Nobody minded.

events.name: The Orchestra: The Conductor
events.intro:
*The old Kricketune doesn't turn. Its wings are worn thin, and its back is very straight.*

*Your Pokégear has one recording on it that you never made: a meadow, at dusk, forty small voices, and one clear note leading all of them.*

*You set the Pokégear down in the grass beside it, and press play.*

success.text: It listens to the whole thing. Every note. When the last one fades it is quiet for a long time. Then it gets up.

events.name: The Orchestra: The Bow
events.intro:
*It walks to the stump, and stops. Then it turns, and bows to you.*

*It bows to you before it bows to them.*

*Forty Kricketot sit absolutely still, and the one from the back row is already coming through the grass toward you.*

success.text: You bow back. The conductor takes its stump. The back-row Kricketot climbs onto your shoe. Behind you the music begins, and it is perfect.

effects.text: Played a Kricketune its own old recording. It bowed to you first.

events.name: The Orchestra: At Night
events.intro:
*Night. Somewhere across the fields, faint, a long way off, forty small voices are tuning up.*

*They find the first note together. They never miss it.*

success.text: You stand a while and listen. The music is faint, and sure of itself, and for as long as it plays you are not the least bit alone.
